cells.title: Source
body: A GitHub issue in openclaw/openclaw was opened on March 8, 2026.
The issue described a data-loss behavior in OpenClaw 2026.3.2 when multiple named agents shared the default workspace directory.

cells.title: Observed behavior
body: The reporter wrote that `openclaw agents delete <name>` moved the shared workspace directory to macOS Trash when deleting one agent.
Because multiple agents referenced the same default workspace, deleting one agent removed files used by the other agents and by the main agent.

cells.output: The reporter wrote that about 190 files or directories were lost, including operational memory, project configs, and integration scripts. Some files were permanently lost after Trash was emptied.

cells.fallback_output: the shared ~/.openclaw/workspace/ directory is moved to Trash
cells.notice: source-recorded reproduction step and observed result

cells.title: Provenance
body: The issue was closed and labeled stale when inspected by the archive. The file records the reporter's bug description, reproduction steps, environment, and stated impact.

cells.title: Notes
body: The artifact is a public issue report, not a maintainer-confirmed postmortem.
The behavior is included because it records an agent-system operation causing filesystem loss under a named-agent configuration.
